subject: Daz
fact: Daz noticed the rocks standing out as stone teeth and shouted a warning.
source_quote: Daz shouts, "Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz directed the crew to heave port or starboard to avoid the rocks.
source_quote: Daz realizes he needs to tell everyone what to do: "On my say, heave port or starboard!"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouted "Port!" to turn the boat away from the first rock.
source_quote: He shouts, "Port!"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouted "Starboard!" to avoid the second rock.
source_quote: He shouts, "Starboard!"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouted "Port! Starboard!" to line up the boat between a pair of rocks.
source_quote: He shouts, "Port! Starboard!"

subject: Daz
fact: Daz reflects on his knowledge of the arcane and his time in the Underdark, believing demons must be summoned with mighty magic.
source_quote: Daz reflects on his knowledge of the arcane and his time in the Underdark, "Demons do not just appear in the Underdark. They must be summoned. And the spell to summon a demon lord is some mighty magic."

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait wails that the Underdark isn't friendly and that rampaging demons and demon lords are terrifying.
source_quote: Spiderbait wails, "This is so not good. The Underdark isn't a friendly place! And rampaging demons and demon lords!"

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth concurs that the danger to all of Faerûn is undeniable and that dwarven miners are at risk.
source_quote: Eldeth concurs, "The danger to all of Faerûn is undeniable. Even if we escape the Underdark, these demons won’t stay down here. And to think someone summoned demon lords! We need to get a warning to the surface worlds. Dwarven miners are at risk!"

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar, recovered from the demon lord’s appearance, mutters that enlightenment is necessary and that Leemooggoogoon was brought into existence by their imagination.
source_quote: Shuushar, finally recovered from the sudden appearance of the demon lord, mutters, "Enlightmnet is necessary! We must change as a people. Our imagination brought into existence, Leemooggoogoon."

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth mutters that Demogorgon being in the prime material plane is not possible.
source_quote: Eldeth mutters, "That was Demogorgon. He’s in the prime material plane. That is not possible."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin stares at Eldeth and says he saw what he saw, regardless of what she thinks is possible.
source_quote: Thorin stares at her, "I am not sure what you think is or is not possible, but I saw what I saw."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says out loud that the spectator warned them about demons and that demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers.
source_quote: Grygum who says it out loud - "The spectator warned us about demons. And we saw the demons in Velkynvelve. Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!"

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido, no longer gagged, says "Gracklstugh! I know people."
source_quote: Buppido, who is no longer gagged, says, "Gracklstugh! I know people."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says they need better equipment and now have the money to buy it.
source_quote: Grygum, however, helps the group decide, "We need better equipment, and we now have the money to buy it."

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar looks at Buppido and says, "Wanna bet?"
source_quote: Jimjar looks at him, "Wanna bet?"

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar acts as a guide and navigator, pointing out where they can find water to drink and food to eat.
source_quote: Shuushar acts as a guide and navigator, pointing out where they can find water to drink and food to eat.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz shouts a warning about rocks that stand out as stone teeth.
source_quote: Daz almost misses the rocks that stand out as stone teeth. He shouts. "Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices everyone else is uncomfortable sitting down and lowering their heads to avoid banging the ceiling.
source_quote: He looks at Zalthir, Shuushar, Grygum, Daz, and Sarith, who are uncomfortable sitting down and lowering their heads to avoid banging them on the ceiling.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notes that it’s good to be short as he observes others are inconvenienced by the low ceiling.
source_quote: "It’s good to be short," Thorin notes as he sees how everyone else isn’t inconvenienced.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin falls into the Darklake along with Grygum and Daz when the boat jerks.
source_quote: he fell in, along with Grygum and Daz.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin notices the creatures in the Darklake look like manta rays with powerful jaws for rending flesh.
source_quote: The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here. They look like manta rays, whose jaws, instead of being used to filter plankton, have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin thinks it’s probably not good that a demonic fish is floating around with the local flora and fauna.
source_quote: he thinks it’s probably not good that a demonic fish is floating around with the local flora and fauna…

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir muses that the ability to cast magical darkness and see through it opens up many tactical opportunities.
source_quote: "The ability to cast magical darkness and see through it opens up so many tactical opportunities," he muses.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is annoyed that he got caught up in a religious ritual that may or may not have summoned Demogorgon.
source_quote: The dragonborn is annoyed that he got caught up in a religious ritual that may or may not have summoned Demogorgon and is now floating through the Darklake in a tiny boat.

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth suggests taking the other boat from the Kuotoans, recalling he almost got sacrificed while selling them weapons.
source_quote: Hemeth seems to be reading Zalthir’s mind when he suggests, "Maybe we take that boat from them? Like the last time I talked to Kuo-Toans, I almost got sacrificed. I was just trying to sell them weapons. I didn’t think they would think sacrificing me was a weapon. Crazy fish people."

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar turns to the group and says he has found his people and will build a better world.
source_quote: Shuushar turns to his fellow escapees and thanks them for their help: "I have found my people, and we will build a better world!"

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says to the group, "They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!"
source_quote: Their Kuo-Toan companion turns to the group, "They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says to Shuushar, "Follow your bliss!"
source_quote: Thorin says - "Follow your bliss!"

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters that he has Shuushar’s instructions but is not sure he can follow them correctly.
source_quote: Sarith mutters a few moments later, "Erm, guys, I have Shuushar’s instructions, but I am not so sure I can follow them correctly."

subject: Sathir's next destination
fact: Sathir mutters, "Where to next?" — the path forward is unresolved.
source_quote: Sathir mutters, "Where to next?"

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum helps the group decide they need better equipment and now have the money to buy it.
source_quote: Grygum, however, helps the group decide, "We need better equipment, and we now have the money to buy it."

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says he knows people who can help with equipment.
source_quote: Buppido sighs, "Yes, and I know people who can help you."

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar looks at Buppido and says, "Wanna bet?"
source_quote: Jimjar looks at him, "Wanna bet?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin gives Shuushar a hug during the farewell.
source_quote: Thorin, who is giving him a hug

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum spits into the lake during the farewell.
source_quote: Grygum spitting into the lake

subject: Daz
fact: Daz looks indifferent during the farewell.
source_quote: Daz looking indifferent

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says thank you as the other Kuo-Toan boat floats off.
source_quote: As the other Kuo-Toan boat floats off, Shuushar says thank you!
